How to Sort a Cluttered Closet

Start by taking everything out of the closet and placing it on the bed. This gives you a clear view of what you actually own.

Make three piles

  1. Keep: things you used in the last year.
  2. Donate: good items you no longer need.
  3. Recycle: worn out or broken items.

Be honest with yourself about each item. If you are unsure, put it in a box with today's date and revisit it in six months.

Put things back

Group similar items together and keep the things you use most at eye level. Label bins so everyone in the house knows where things go.

Finally, book a donation drop off for the next weekend so the pile does not sit around.
